faqs.q: Can you fix my garbage disposal the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day service is our standard in Houston and nearby cities. Most disposal jobs — jams, resets, leaks or a full replacement — are finished in a single visit.
Yes. The technician inspects the disposal, finds the fault and gives you a free estimate before any work starts — whether that is a repair or a replacement.

faqs.q: What warranty does the work have?
faqs.a: Repairs and installations are covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

faqs.q: My disposal hums but does not grind. What does that mean?
faqs.a: The motor is getting power but the grinding plate is jammed, usually by a bone fragment, a fruit pit, glass or a utensil. Do not keep pressing the switch — the motor can burn out. Shut it off and book a visit; clearing a jam is a quick repair.

faqs.q: Is a leaking garbage disposal repairable?
faqs.a: It depends on where it leaks. Leaks at the sink flange or the hose connections are repairable. A leak from the bottom of the body usually means the internal seals have failed, and replacing the unit is the sensible fix. We confirm which case you have before quoting.

faqs.q: Do you repair or replace? Which brands do you install?
faqs.a: Both. If a repair is not worth it, we can install a new disposal in the same visit. We work on common brands found in Houston kitchens, including InSinkErator and its Badger series, Waste King, Moen, GE, KitchenAid and Whirlpool.

faqs.q: What should never go into a garbage disposal?
faqs.a: Grease and cooking oil, coffee grounds, eggshells in quantity, fibrous scraps like celery and corn husks, pasta and rice that swell, bones and fruit pits. Run cold water before, during and for a few seconds after grinding.
